fallback_when_unresolved: Carry one configuration per OBJECTIVE (the best 'utility' and the best 'robust_sharpe'), regardless of their relative rank.

Rationale: when the screen cannot separate configurations, ranking is noise, so carry forward along the axis the brief exists to compare rather than along a noise ordering. Ties within an objective break by lower turnover, then lower gamma, then lower seed - all pre-registered, none data-dependent.
note: Recording this after seeing results voids it (plan.md Complexity Tracking).
primary: Rank configurations by the interquartile mean of net log return across seeds on the screening fold's TEST range; carry the top 2.
resolvability_test: Bootstrap the IQM difference between rank-1 and rank-3. The screen RESOLVES only if that 95% CI excludes zero.
